Everything we offer / Workshop

Mock excavation

A hands-on workshop in which students excavate and record a prepared trench

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

A trench is prepared in advance with layers and planted finds. Students excavate it with real tools, record each find and its position, and then interpret what happened at the site.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Laying out a trench and digging it layer by layer
  • Recording each find and where it lay
  • Working out, as a team, what happened at the site

How the time is spent

  1. Trench briefing 30 min

    Mock grid, strata and context logic.

    You: role assignment

  2. Simulated excavation 60 min

    Excavate prepared sandbox with safe tools.

    You: context sheets

  3. Interpret finds 60 min

    Build stratigraphic sequence.

    You: context diagram

  4. Debrief 30 min

    Discuss what remains unknowable.

    You: site report

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

A portfolio of your work from each session.
